sourceTitle: The Teacher Moral Influences Employed in the Instruction and Government of the Young
description: "The Teacher" by Jacob Abbott is a practical instructional guide for educators, written in the mid-19th century. The book focuses on the application of moral influences in the management and instruction of young learners, advocating for approaches that prioritize authority based on moral grounds rather than physical discipline.
